Calculate input and output column names for an {epiprocess} dplyr::across-like operations

Source: R/epi_slide_opt_edf.R
across_ish_names_info.Rd

Calculate input and output column names for an {epiprocess} dplyr::across-like operations

Usage

across_ish_names_info(
  .x,
  time_type,
  col_names_quo,
  .f_namer,
  .window_size,
  .align,
  .prefix,
  .suffix,
  .new_col_names
)

Arguments

.x

data.frame to perform input column tidyselection on

time_type

as in new_epi_df

col_names_quo

enquosed input column tidyselect expression

.f_namer

function taking an input column object and outputting a name for a corresponding output column; see upstream_slide_f_info

.window_size

as in epi_slide_opt

.align

as in epi_slide_opt

.prefix

as in epi_slide_opt

.suffix

as in epi_slide_opt

.new_col_names

as in epi_slide_opt

Value

named list with two elements: input_col_names, chr, subset of names(.x); and output_colnames, chr, same length as input_col_names
